summary: Bion Environmental Technologies filed an 8-K on June 11, 2026, reporting a six-month extension of a Memorandum of Understanding with Kimmeridge Energy Management, LLC, effective June 6, 2026. The MOU, originally dated December 5, 2025, outlines a preliminary, non-binding framework for collaboration on Bion's ammonium bicarbonate technology and a potential joint venture, including a Right of First Refusal. The extension maintains all original terms. No financial terms, definitive agreements, or binding transaction commitments are disclosed. This is a routine update on an ongoing exploratory arrangement, not a special situation event.
